checks.finding: Requirements REQ-001–REQ-007 have inspectable outcomes: artifact consumption, install-state equality, native hook observations, normalization fixtures, drift diagnostics, evidence classification, and traceability. AC-001–AC-030 provide corresponding validation decisions. This Phase 1 check does not require implementation or completed evidence.

acceptance-tests.md:5–34 maps all thirty criteria to one primary requirement each. REQ-001–REQ-007 each have matching criteria; AC-028 maps to REQ-003, and the scope/citation process checks AC-029/AC-030 map to REQ-007.

The criteria specify observable artifacts or states, including consumer output influenced by upstream files (AC-002–AC-004), unchanged reinstall state and zero residue (AC-008/AC-009), native-dispatch denial or expected unavailability (AC-013–AC-016), distinct drift exits (AC-023), and aggregate rejection of invalid proof records (AC-028).

requirements.md:233–260 explicitly excludes other epics' implementation duties, FilesOnly from the four-target matrix, canonicalizer-layer normalization, and producing implementation or live-session evidence during specification authoring. AC-029 makes the integration-only boundary independently inspectable.

The amendment declaration does not meet the calibration's mandatory full-commit-hash evidence bar. investigation.md:630–645 identifies an investigation amendment only as 'This commit' and by its changed-file shape; investigation.md:691–703 identifies another design/investigation amendment only by date and changed-file shape. Neither entry supplies that amendment's full commit hash. A document SHA-256 does not replace the separately required amendment commit identity. Consequently, the calibration's all-or-nothing phase-sequencing suppression cannot apply. requirements.md:3 remains Pending while requirements.md:34–42 and investigation.md:151–157,511–529 reference existing later-phase work. The downstream gate cannot establish the declared amendment exception from a conforming authorization record. This belongs to specification review's launch-to-Phase-1 approval boundary, rather than implementation verification; Critical follows the calibration's default treatment of an unmet amendment exception. Append the missing full amendment commit references and rerun this gate.

The live-host authenticity risk has planned validation through AC-015, AC-026–AC-028: nonce uniqueness, independently recomputed capture hashes, expected config digests, two-party signatures, and aggregate failure conditions. AC-017 independently protects synthetic regression coverage, while AC-022/AC-023 cover lifecycle drift and mode-specific absence behavior.
